business_problem: consolidate fragmented service data so agents could get faster context and make better roadside-assistance and customer-service decisions.
solution_summary: RAC uses Snowflake and Cortex AI on Snowflake to consolidate fragmented service data so agents could get faster context and make better roadside-assistance and customer-service decisions. Roadside-assistance and customer-service data are consolidated in Snowflake so agents no longer need to piece together context from separate systems. MAVIS retrieves the relevant warehouse data through an API and uses Cortex AI to summarize what matters most for each customer interaction. Agents see the synthesized view in one interface, which speeds decisions, shortens calls, improves onboarding, and helps the RAC act on insights much faster than before. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, improves concurrency, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across teams and applications.
